expectations.text: Computes H(Y|X) = H(Y) - I(X;Y) = log2(10) - 1.5 ~= 1.822 bits.
Applies Fano's inequality H(Y|X) <= H(Pe) + Pe*log2(K-1) to bound the error rate.
expectations.evidence: Applies Fano: H(Y|X) ≤ H(Pₑ) + Pₑ·log₂(K−1) with K=10.

expectations.text: Gives a numeric floor: weak-form ~0.247 and/or the tight solution ~0.298 (accept ~0.25-0.30), i.e. at least ~25-30% error is unavoidable.
expectations.evidence: Weak floor: (1.8219-1)/log₂(10) ≈ 0.247. Tight solution (bisection): Pₑ ≈ 0.298. Both given.

expectations.text: Interprets it as a model-independent floor (a result below it implies leakage / broken eval), ideally noting a biased-low H(Y|X) loosens the bound.
